production.note: US model years 2019-2023. Dodge's 2019 fact sheet (June 28, 2018) introduces "the 797-horsepower Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat Redeye" as part of "the most powerful SRT Hellcat lineup ever in 2019". Dodge's 2023 specifications still list the SRT Hellcat Redeye (source dodge-challenger-specs-2023); Challenger production at Brampton ended on December 22, 2023 (GM Authority, source gmauthority-challenger-end-2023). Sold as its own trim: Mopar Insiders, "Unlike the Redeye, the SRT HELLCAT gets the option of both a 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic" and the Hellcat automatic "starts out $8,005 cheaper than its standard base SRT HELLCAT Redeye counterpart" (source moparinsiders-2019-hellcat-pricing).

body.note: Two-door coupe. The Widebody is an option package with its own weight line ("SRT Hellcat Redeye Widebody"), not a separate model.

displacementL.note: 6,166 cc. Dodge 2023 specifications: "Displacement 376 cu. in. (6,166 cu. cm.)".

drivetrain.note: Rear-wheel drive; Dodge's sheets offer AWD only with the V-6.

transmission.note: "TORQUEFLITE 8HP90 Eight-Speed Automatic: Optional — Challenger SRT Hellcat; standard on SRT Hellcat Redeye". The TR-6060 manual is listed as "Standard — Challenger SRT Hellcat" only; Dodge's 2019 fact sheet: "TorqueFlite eight-speed automatic" on the Redeye (source dodge-challenger-factsheet-2019). The 2023 sheet is the same: "Optional — SRT Hellcat; standard on SRT Hellcat Redeye and SRT Super Stock".

powerHp.note: Quote (Dodge 2019 specifications, Supercharged 6.2-Liter HEMI Hellcat High Output, "Standard — Challenger SRT Hellcat Redeye"): "797 bhp (595 kW) @6,300 rpm with Premium 91 octane fuel". Unchanged to the end: Dodge 2023 specifications, "Power 797 bhp (595 kW) @ 6,300 rpm / 807 bhp (601 Kw) @ 6,400 rpm on SRT Super Stock" (source dodge-challenger-specs-2023).

weightLb.note: 2019 model, standard body (8-speed automatic, the only transmission), standard rear seat. Quote (Dodge 2019 specifications, Curb Weight): "4,451 (2,019) — SRT Hellcat Redeye"; the row "4,400 (1,996) — SRT Hellcat Redeye without rear seat" is a seat-delete option and is not used. The heading carries no preliminary or estimate label. 2023: "4,430 (2,009) — SRT Hellcat Redeye" and "4,481 (2,032) — SRT Hellcat Redeye Widebody" (source dodge-challenger-specs-2023).

sources.title: 2019 Dodge Challenger / Challenger SRT Fact Sheet (June 28, 2018)
2019 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat Options and Pricing, by Robert S. Miller (September 1, 2018)
Production Of Camaro Rival Dodge Challenger Ends Today, by Jonathan Lopez (December 22, 2023)

discrepancies.reason: Model year: both are Dodge curb weights for the standard-body Redeye, 4,451 lb on the 2019 sheet and 4,430 lb on the 2023 sheet.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 4,451 lb because the reference model year is 2019, the launch year.
